mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USERBADGE UB USING ( SELECT #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} as U_ID, BADGE_ID as B_ID, #{groupId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} as G_ID FROM BADGE WHERE CHALLENGE_ID = #{challengeId} ) SRC ON ( UB.USER_ID = SRC.U_ID AND UB.BADGE_ID = SRC.B_ID AND NVL(UB.GROUPB_ID, 0) = NVL(SRC.G_ID, 0) ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, BADGE_ID, EARNED_AT, GROUPB_ID) VALUES ( SRC.U_ID, SRC.B_ID, SYSDATE, SRC.G_ID )
mapper.select: SELECT UB.USER_ID AS userId, UB.BADGE_ID AS badgeId, UB.EARNED_AT AS earnedAt, B.BADGE_NAME AS badgeName, B.BADGE_ICON_URL AS badgeIconUrl, B.CHALLENGE_ID AS challengeId, C.DESCRIPTION AS challengeDesc, gb.TITLE AS groupBudgetTitle FROM USERBADGE UB JOIN BADGE B ON UB.BADGE_ID = B.BADGE_ID LEFT JOIN CHALLENGES C ON C.CHALLENGE_ID = B.CHALLENGE_ID LEFT JOIN GROUPBUDGET gb ON ub.GROUPB_ID = gb.GROUPB_ID WHERE UB.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UB.EARNED_AT DESC
